title: zotero-plugin-index entry fields
description: Fields of plugins/<id>/index.json: the data the index keeps beside the registry meta.json.

overrides.description: Corrections to upstream facts that the plugin author cannot or will not fix upstream. A description override can also give English text for a plugin whose manifest and GitHub descriptions are each missing, not in English, only repeat the name, or are half or more Chinese, Japanese, or Korean. It can also replace an English description of fewer than six words that the site shows without the override.

value.description: For languages: one or more language tags joined by ", ", such as "zh-CN, en-US".

field.description: The upstream fact this override corrects.

version.description: The plugin version the override applies to. Absent means every version.

reason.description: Why the upstream value is wrong, or, for English description text, the upstream source it was drawn from and, for the manifest and GitHub descriptions, whether each is missing, not in English, only repeats the name, has a CJK share of 0.5 or more, as the README counts it, or is in English with fewer than six words, or that it is in English and not shown.
